title: typo3-wcag22-aa-agentic: the skill at work
description: WCAG 2.2 AA scans, a report and a statement draft. Recorded from a real scan of nine pages of this lab’s Odera template site. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 47 seconds: the typo3-wcag22-aa-agentic agent skill. Playwright and axe-core scan nine pages of a TYPO3 template site in 29 states. The report lists each violation by page and theme file, with a draft accessibility statement. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: The European Accessibility Act is law. Checking every page by hand is slow.
You ask for every WCAG failure, page by page.
Playwright and axe-core scan nine pages in twenty-nine states, in under a minute.
The report lists each violation by page and drafts the accessibility statement.
Scans are evidence, not a conformance claim. A person reviews the rest.
